user.title: Parcel Tracker
user.description:
Enter your API keys below to enable reliable tracking. Both keys are free and optional — you can also add them later via the integration settings.

**DHL API Key** (DHL Express + DHL Germany) — Free, 250 calls/day.
→ Register at [developer.dhl.com](https://developer.dhl.com), create an app and copy the **Consumer Key**.

**pkge.net API Key** (DPD + 4PX / China Post) — Free, 50 parcels/month.
→ Register at [business.pkge.net](https://business.pkge.net), go to **Company profile → API key**.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Parcel Tracker is already installed. Manage your parcels via the sidebar panel.
